underlines.text: unless Mr. Darcy returned within the stated time

reference.text: His friend had left him that morning for London, but was to return home in ten days’ time.

underlines.text: Bingley was punctual to his appointment

reference.text: He scarcely needed an invitation to stay supper; and before he went away an engagement was formed, chiefly through his own and Mrs. Bennet’s means, for his coming next morning to shoot with her husband.

underlines.text: her mother had been too ingenious for her

reference.text: Bingley of course returned with him to dinner; and in the evening Mrs. Bennet’s invention was again at work to get everybody away from him and her daughter.
